messages.trust.title: Lony Trust
messages.trust.youAreGrade: You are grade {grade} in Lony Trust
messages.trust.notEnough: Not enough Lony activity to grade yet
messages.trust.gradesIntro: Grades summarize how you use Lony — repayments, debt load, consistency, liquidity, savings, and goals.
messages.trust.gradeABody: Strong repayment history, healthy balances, and steady cashflow on Lony. Peers can lend with high confidence.
messages.trust.gradeBBody: Reliable overall. A few gaps or thinner history, but activity looks solid for peer lending.
messages.trust.gradeCBody: Mixed signals — some repayment or liquidity pressure. Keep confirming income and paying on time to improve.
messages.trust.gradeDBody: Higher risk from missed patterns, thin history, or tight cash. Focus on clearing dues and building a buffer.
messages.trust.gradeEBody: Low trust based on current Lony activity. Rebuild with consistent repayments and clearer cashflow tracking.
